## History

Jordan was given a farm by his father, where he built a small house and brought his wife, Hester, to live in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after she agreed to marry him on the condition that they move to a quiet location surrounded by fields and trees. He cared for Hester tenderly and without assistance during her illness until her death four years later. Following her passing, Jordan sold the farm and returned to [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) to work, eventually dying about ten years later and being buried beside his wife.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P54](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0054), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P62](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0062), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P63](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0063), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P65](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0065), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P66](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0066), +8 more_
